mapper.select:
SELECT SUM (CASE WHEN date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS expiredCount, SUM ( case when date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) >= 0 and date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) <= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as almostOverdueCount, SUM ( case when date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) > 7 and date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as inOneMonthCount, SUM ( case when date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) > 30 and date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as inTwoMonthCount, SUM ( case when date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as twoMonthLaterCount from purchase_order_detail as pod where pod.is_deleted = false and pod.execution_status in ('confirm','delivery')
and pod.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
